reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the audio experience in Provincia. No more hard cuts in our day, night, title, and combat music beds! Instead, we've implemented a smooth crossfade that enhances the overall immersion. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
